primary_estimand: paired seed difference in in-support target-hit rate relative to random enumeration

arms.conditional_knn: inverse generator sampling formulations near requested conductivity and temperature in standardized condition space
arms.forward_optimization: frozen-surrogate grid ranking; strong non-generative baseline

split: 80/20 by salt+molality formulation group; all temperatures from a formulation stay together
queries: three within-training-support conductivity quantiles at 303.15, 343.15, and 363.15 K
hit_definition: absolute frozen-verifier target error < 0.25 log10(S/cm), bootstrap SD < 0.35, and salt/loading/temperature within training support
proposal_model: 20 formulation-group bootstrap fits of the Experiment B fixed-T0 VTF ridge model
independent_verifier: 300-tree random forest over salt identity, molality, and temperature; never used for proposal or optimization
interpretation_boundary: 80 kDa PCL only; formulation-selection benchmark, not cross-polymer generation
